title: SBA disaster home loan document request
use_when: Use when a homeowner or renter is applying for an SBA disaster loan for a home or personal property on SBA Form 5C; use the business list for businesses and nonprofits.
note: Items follow the filing requirements printed on SBA Form 5C (05/23). SBA advises applicants in writing of the documents it needs before loan closing. The form edition read shows an OMB expiration date of 07/31/26, so check sba.gov for a newer edition before relying on this list.

sba-form-5c.name: SBA Form 5C, Disaster Home Loan Application (05/23; OMB expiration date shown 07/31/26)

situations.job-change: Has any applicant changed employment within the past two years?
situations.owns-residence: Does the applicant own the residence?
situations.primary-residence: Is the damaged property the applicant's primary residence?
situations.vehicle: Was an automobile or other vehicle damaged?
situations.non-citizen: Is any applicant not a United States citizen?

items.label: Disaster number
items.detail: Form 5C says it can be found at sba.gov/disaster.

items.label: Most recent federal tax return
items.detail: Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: Information about the insurance policies on the home
items.detail: Form 5C asks for the insurance company name, policy number and current amount received, if any.

items.label: Personal details for the applicant and any Joint Borrower to be included in the application
items.detail: Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: Copy of a green card or proof of permanent residency
items.detail: Form 5C says a non-citizen may need to provide a copy of specific documents like these. Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: SBA Form 5C, completed and signed
items.detail: Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: IRS Form 4506-C, Tax Information Authorization, completed and signed
items.detail: Enclosed with the application. Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

items.label: Copy of a current pay stub for all applicants
items.detail: Current means within 1 month of the application date. If requested, provide within 7 days of the information request.

items.label: Copies of Federal income tax returns, including all schedules
items.detail: Asked for if SBA needs additional income information. If requested, provide within 7 days of the information request. Send through the secure portal, never by plain email.

sections.name: Before loan closing, if SBA approves the loan

items.label: COMPLETE legible copy of the deed, including the legal description of the property
Proof of residency at the damaged address
Copy of the manufactured home title
items.detail: If the applicant owns the lot where the home is located, also a COMPLETE legible copy of the deed, including the legal description of the property.

items.label: Proof of ownership of the vehicle (a copy of the registration, title, bill of sale, etc.)
